# pottle

> a pot for the group chat. set a goal and a deadline, share one link. friends chip in with usdc (or eurc) on arc. hit the goal and the pot goes to the organiser; miss the deadline and everyone gets back exactly what they put in, automatically.

## what it is
- the money goes to the person who made the pot (the organiser), who buys the gift or pays the bill. every pot shows who it goes to before anyone chips in
- group collections for gifts and shared costs: birthdays, leaving gifts, trips, dinners
- all-or-nothing: the money is held by a smart contract until the goal is hit or the deadline passes
- if a pot hit its goal but still could not pay out 30 days after its deadline (for example a frozen organiser account), everyone can take their money back
- nobody can take a pot early, including the organiser and the people who built pottle. the contract has no owner, no admin and no fee
- friends sign in with their email; pottle pays the network fee for payments of $1 or more, so they only sign once
- pots can be in dollars (usdc) or euros (eurc)
- no usdc yet? add money inside pottle through circle's onramp: card, apple pay, google pay or bank transfer, where circle offers it
- making a pot costs about half a cent, paid from the organiser's wallet; pottle sends an empty new wallet one cent for its first pot
- in beta (no third-party audit yet) a pot holds at most $1,000 or €1,000. the contract enforces it

## how it uses arc
- arc is circle's layer 1 for stablecoin payments. fees are paid in usdc and payments settle in about half a second
- chip-ins use eip-3009 (receiveWithAuthorization) on circle's usdc and eurc, so a payment is a single signature
- payouts and refunds are triggered automatically: when anyone opens a pot that is due, and by a scheduled job

## where it runs
- live on arc mainnet with real usdc: https://pottle.xyz
- free to try on arc testnet with test dollars: https://test.pottle.xyz
- the contract on arc mainnet: 0xB53D47878283C2f2D44739B39c1B576469A50D5c (source verified, https://explorer.arc.io/address/0xB53D47878283C2f2D44739B39c1B576469A50D5c)
